## History

Roger Pye is mentioned in connection to his relative, [Joshua Pye](../character/joshua-pye.md), who was involved in a painting mix-up at the village hall. Due to a confusion over paint numbers, Joshua painted the hall a bright blue rather than the intended green. This mistake initially caused dismay among the [Improvers](../codex/factions.md#improvers), but public sympathy ultimately turned in their favor as the community rallied to support them.

_Sources: [v2 IX A Question of Color P0](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0000), [v2 IX A Question of Color P28](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0028), [v2 IX A Question of Color P32](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0032), [v2 IX A Question of Color P40](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0040)_
